source.mappingDecision: The source's three factors are split 1:n into temperature, pH and substrate-concentration goals; this goal is the substrate-concentration branch. The saturation explanation is a bounded operationalization of that branch, not a verbatim source requirement.
source.learnerFacingScope: The target goal is explicitly present in the HE SekII GK and LK source views.

positiveEvidence.contentFinding: Two independent controlled initial-rate cases use different enzyme/substrate pairs; the second also tests a pH confounder. Both require interpreting the plateau through limited active-site capacity and reject causal claims when other conditions vary. No observed learner performance or human approval is asserted.
positiveEvidence.correction: Corrected the source-page claim from printed p.36 to printed p.34 and rematerialized the profile; also regenerated the stale review record after its application-case identifier disagreed with the lowercase authoring candidate.

image.finding: Viewed original and an actual 360 px wide preview. The equal enzyme count, greater substrate concentration, concentration-axis label and qualitative plateau are discernible; the large labels remain readable. The image is a schematic teaching aid, not measured evidence. Public and canonical PNG copies exactly match the V-ledger hash; AI approval yes, human approval no.
